//: What Emrys may do that changes something. Reads and generation always run; this file decides everything else. Each list holds tool-name patterns, where * matches anything: "Bash", "mcp__emrys_chrome__chrome_click", "mcp__android__*". deny beats allow beats ask, and anything unlisted gets 'default'. 'ask' puts a card on screen and waits for you to say or click yes. Background jobs never ask: with nobody there to answer, anything not allowed is refused and written up under Proposed actions instead. Saved changes apply to the next action.
